title: Seahawks seem to think Terrion Arnold would be available to play in preseason

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks seem to think Terrion Arnold would be available to play in preseason
sources.description: The second episode of Hard Knocks featuring the Seahawks (which was grossly overhyped as potentially the best episode in series history) included multiple references to the team's recent workout of former Lions first-round cornerback Terrion Arnold.
